title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence: client.gleam:5802-5804 in enter_demo: `auth: Success(landlord),\n          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",\n          demo_mode: True,` (no preservation of prior auth); model.gleam:752 in clear_demo_state: `auth: NotAsked,`
detail: A logged-in landlord who opens /demo loses SPA session state unconditionally and exits to auth NotAsked; they must re-auth client-side even though their session cookie is intact.
recommended_fix: Preserve and restore the pre-demo auth on exit, or re-run auth_api.check_session after clear_demo_state on demo exit.

title: still present since round 3: demo exit via the banner CTA from a dirty edit page clears demo state before the unsaved-changes guard fires
evidence:
client.gleam:496: `handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)`; the guard inside handle_browser_change (5391-5399): `case model.vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes {
            True -> #(
              Model(
                ..updated_model,
                route: model.route,
                show_unsaved_changes_prompt: True,
                unsaved_changes_destination: Some(r),
              ),
              modem.replace("/vacancies/" <> edit_id <> "/edit", None, None),` — and clear_demo_state (model.gleam:747-768) does not clear vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes.
detail: On a dirty demo edit page the exit path clears demo state first; the guard still sees vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes and URL-replaces back to /vacancies/<demo-id>/edit after exit — 'keep editing' lands on a real fetch for a fixture id.
recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clearing demo state, or suppress the prompt when the destination exits the demo.

title: still present since round 3: latent policy re-acceptance modal could surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST
evidence:
client.gleam:1356-1365: `UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy(
            version: model.server_policy_version,
            csrf_token: model.csrf_token,
            on_response: ApiReturnedAcceptPolicy,
          ),
        )` — no demo guard; grep of client/src/demo/demo_update.gleam finds no UserAcceptedPolicy interception; scripts/lint_demo_network.py:55 still lists "UserAcceptedPolicy" in EXEMPT_ARMS.
detail: Latent only (fixture pins accepted_policy_version), but a server policy bump surfaces the modal inside demo and the accept click fires a real POST with the demo's bogus CSRF token.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.handle (no-op with toast), keeping the lint manifest honest.

title: still present since round 3: demo comparison ids write to real web storage
evidence: client.gleam:3527 `save_comparison_ids(new_ids)` and 3541 `save_comparison_ids(new_ids)` in UserToggledComparison (no demo guard; reachable via demo_update fallthrough), and 5412/5417 `save_comparison_ids([])` in handle_browser_change's comparison-reset arm which runs in demo mode.
detail: Demo interactions persist demo fixture ids into the real product's localStorage keys; a demo -> signup path hydrates real screens with demo comparison ids.
recommended_fix: Namespace demo storage keys or skip save_comparison_ids while model.demo_mode is True.

title: still present since round 3: comparison deep link passes persisted real localStorage ids into the demo store and skips the navigation path's empty-ids guard
evidence:
client.gleam:5885-5891 in demo_entry_effects: `routes.Comparison(vid) -> [
      demo_api.fetch_comparison(
        store,
        vid,
        load_comparison_ids(),
        ApiReturnedComparisonDetails,
      ),
    ]` — unconditional load_comparison_ids(); the navigation path (handle_browser_change Comparison arm) guards on `[] -> #(updated_model, eff)`.
detail: A real landlord's persisted comparison ids (real UUIDs) are looked up in the demo store on boot — the demo comparison deep link lands empty; the two fetch paths disagree.
recommended_fix: Mirror the navigation path's empty-ids guard and prefer fixture ids in demo.

title: still present since round 3: demo boot skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the page lifetime
detail: Boot-time hydrations (comparison ids, dismissed nudges) never run on a demo-first boot and the visibility listener is never installed for the page lifetime.
recommended_fix: Install the listener on demo entry or document the divergence.

title: still present since round 3: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry; per-surface analytics undercount the primary entry path
evidence: client.gleam:5861-5863: `fn demo_entry_effects(store: DemoStore, route: Route) -> Effect(Msg) {\n  let base = [demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications)]\n  let route_eff = case route {` — no demo_analytics.capture_event anywhere in demo_entry_effects; only enter_demo:5784 fires `demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_entry)`. In-session navigation does fire them (e.g. handle_browser_change VacancyDetail arm).
detail: A fresh boot into /vacancies/v-maples counts demo_entry but not demo_vacancy_open, while the identical in-session navigation counts both — engagement metrics undercount shared-URL entries.
recommended_fix: Fire the matching surface event in demo_entry_effects' route arms.

title: still present since round 3: failed demo seed desyncs model.route from the browser URL
evidence:
client.gleam:5852-5855, enter_demo Error arm: `Error(_) -> #(
      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
      effect.none(),
    )`
detail: On seed failure the address bar stays /demo (or the deep link) while Landing renders; no navigation effect, no feedback.
recommended_fix: Return modem.replace("/", None, None) so the rendered route matches the URL.

title: still present since round 3: edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame — enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading
evidence: client.gleam:5845-5847 in enter_demo: `// A deep-linked demo edit page needs its id set so the\n          // get_for_edit response is accepted and the form can load.\n          vacancy_edit_id: edit_id,` — the Model update sets vacancy_edit_id but never vacancy_edit_loading (vacancies/dashboard_stats get Loading arms; the edit page does not).
detail: The get_for_edit payload lands but the first frame shows the empty form instead of the skeleton on a /vacancies/v-*/edit boot.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when the boot route is VacancyEdit.

title: still present since round 3: unreachable routes.Demo arm in view_protected_page duplicates the demo render
detail: view_page matches routes.Demo (view_demo_page) before the protected catch-all, so this arm can never fire; the duplicate render call remains, now with an explanatory comment.
recommended_fix: Fold into the Dashboard arm: `routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)`.
